channel.title: The Booty Bay Chronicle
channel.description: Last 10 notes on The Booty Bay Chronicle

item.title: House Rules
item.description: My deviations from the printed rules. Logged so I stay consistent.

item.title: Magic Schools and Damage Types
item.description: Azeroth runs on six. Everything resistible falls into one.

item.title: Playable Species at Launch
item.description: Eight, and only eight. Four to a side.

item.title: Reputation as a Mechanic
item.description: Vanilla’s eight-rank ladder, run as a real subsystem rather than a progress bar.

item.title: Species of the Sourcebook
item.description: The D&D World of Warcraft Sourcebook offers 16 species — 11 new, plus WoW-mapping rules for 5 that already exist in the 2024 Player’s Handbook.

item.title: Travel and Downtime
item.description: Decided at the table Hearthstones exist, once per week. Flight paths exist and are expensive. Ground mounts are the normal way to cover distance.

item.title: Front Page
item.description: Printed in Booty Bay, where we sell to anyone who pays and ask nobody their business. Year 29 since the opening of the Dark Portal.

item.title: Frostmourne
item.description: Appearance A greatsword of black ice with a skull in the crossguard, and it is cold in a way that has nothing to do with temperature.

item.title: Gorehowl
item.description: Appearance A huge orcish axe with a notch worn into the blade from a single, very famous blow.
